The capabilities of the server

Source: R/capabilities.R
soil_capabilities.Rd

The deployment contract of the API, GET /capabilities: API and response schema versions, authentication (the audience of the rights), the limits advertised for this deployment (max_page_size, max_sync_observations, max_export_observations, max_publication_bytes), formats, exports, filters, the capability flags (capabilities), the profile types (profile_types) and the views with their revised rules (views).

Usage

soil_capabilities(soil = soil_session(), refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

refresh

Read the capabilities from the server again. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

The /capabilities object as a named list (as parsed, nothing renamed).

Details

The capabilities are read once after the login and kept in the session; refresh = TRUE reads them again and repeats the version check of soil_connect().

Rights: soil:summary.

See also

soil_api_info() for the versions and the compatibility of the server with this client.

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_citations(), soil_code_list(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
caps <- soil_capabilities(soil)
caps$api_version
caps$limits$max_sync_observations
names(Filter(isTRUE, caps$capabilities))
} # }
